exact_statement: For every n>=1, every quadratic q:F_2^n->F_2, every linear address map M, and distinct u,v with Mu=Mv, the actual Boolean F=(-1)^q(1-2*1_{u,v})y_{Mx}, with independent distinct named data signs, has the signed coefficient and physical influence ledgers of DERIVATION.md section 1. The address-first, then nonzero-restricted-polar-row stopping tree has B_i<=4 Inf_i at every queried node, hence zero localized bad-boundary bill at K=4, retains exactly one weighted data influence, and proves H(F)<=(4+2/ln(2))(I(F)-1)<7(I(F)-1) when I(F)>1 (H=0 if I(F)=1). The specified four-control separator tree violates B_i<=2 Inf_i at one descendant: Inf_i=1/4, B_i=1+(5/8)log2(5)-(9/8)log2(3), C_i=1, node weight 1/2.
hypotheses: Uniform independent sign controls and data, entropy in bits; q degree at most two including arbitrary linear part.
Different address values have different independent physical data coordinates; repetitions of the same value share one physical coordinate.
The K=2 obstruction concerns the specified representation-pivot tree, not all possible adaptive stopping rules or the full FEI conjecture.
